name: Paperwork Sorter
meta: Drop in the pile: invoices, W-9s, insurance certificates, notices. Each one named, filed, entered, and the missing paperwork chased.
duty_quote: Follow up aggressively on missing or expired documentation
source_line: From a Twin Cities job posting, October 2026.
turn_html: That line describes a step, not a person. Here is the step, done on a pile of paperwork like yours: each document named, filed, its fields pulled out for the system, and what is missing chased.
input_label: The pile (example, edit or paste yours)
paid_extra: up to 25 a run, with who to chase, the follow-up notes and the spreadsheet
pay_line: Every document you paste or upload, up to 25 a run, as often as you like. Plus who is missing what, a follow-up note to each, and the spreadsheet to paste into your system.

foot_html: The pile on the left is made up. Separate pasted documents with a line of three dashes. Put a line starting CHECKLIST: at the top to say what every party owes you.
